notes.key_messages:
• Candidates need to be careful to read the question in detail and answer as indicated.
• Candidates need to take care to avoid numerical and algebraic errors.
• Marks depend on giving answers which are correct to 3 significant figures. In order to gain as many
marks as possible all working should be either exact or correct to at least 4 significant figures.
